title: Device Identifier
description: Defines a device identifier for matching.

device_address.description: Bluetooth address (Bluetooth MAC address) of the device.

is_keyboard.description: True if the device is a keyboard.

is_pointing_device.description: True if the device is a pointing device.

is_game_pad.description: True if the device is a game pad.

is_consumer.description: True if the device is a consumer device.

is_touch_bar.description: True if the device is a touch bar.

is_built_in_keyboard.description: True if the device is a built-in keyboard.
